basic_info.description: Wonderful 2 unit Parkside building, in one of City's most sought-after neighborhoods, with an enviable location near Taraval Street and all the conveniences it affords, offering its residents a splendid lifestyle. Both units have nicely appointed updated kitchens with dedicated dining spaces. The large East-facing living rooms have beautiful morning light and original details such as hardwood floors and decorative molding making the units ideal for comfortable everyday living. The units boast efficient floor plans with 2 spacious bedrooms, 1 bathroom and separate living room and kitchen/dining areas. The bright kitchens have western light, granite countertops, ample cabinetry, and convenient access to the backyard and garage from the back staircase. Although currently used for single car parking, garage could fit 2 vehicles, and laundry appliances, systems and storage, adding value to the property. The building is currently tenant occupied and offers an investment opportunity to a new owner who will enjoy an asset in one of the city's most scenic areas. The Parkside neighborhood combines suburban tranquility with urban convenience, making this an appealing location for both owners and renters.
